Got my tire fixed by these guys they over tightened my lug nuts which broke my studs, and was told there's nothing they'll do about it and i couldn't talk to any owner. The two managers weren't even listening. They are very unprofessional, i got laughed at and walked off on.

Last night, I paid this shop to install four TPMS sensors that I purchased, based on their positive Google reviews. Today, two of the four sensors they installed were loose, causing all the air to leak out. As a result, two of my tires blew out on the road (see attached photo), and I had to replace both tires.

Any competent tire shop should be able to install TPMS sensors correctly, but the workmanship here was so poor that they failed to secure the sensors properly. Their service doesn’t even deserve one star.
